mapper.select: SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.MATCH_DATE, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'MM')) >= 8 THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) - 1 END AS SEASON, CEIL(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE ASC, m.MATCH_ID ASC) / 10) AS ROUND, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, m.STATUS, m.NOTICE, m.ENDED_AT, NVL(h.TEAM_NAME, '구단 ' || m.HOME_TEAM_ID) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, NVL(h.TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.TEAM_NAME) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.EMBLEM_URL AS HOME_EMBLEM_URL, h.HOME_GROUND, h.HOME_GROUND_KOR, NVL(a.TEAM_NAME, '구단 ' || m.AWAY_TEAM_ID) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME, NVL(a.TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.TEAM_NAME) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.EMBLEM_URL AS AWAY_EMBLEM_URL FROM MATCHES m LEFT JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID WHERE m.MATCH_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{season} || '-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND m.MATCH_DATE < TO_DATE((#{season} + 1) || '-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE ASC, m.MATCH_ID ASC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO MATCHES m USING (SELECT #{matchId} AS MATCH_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (m.MATCH_ID = s.MATCH_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET m.MATCH_DATE = #{matchDateValue, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, m.HOME_SCORE = #{homeScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, m.AWAY_SCORE = #{awayScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, m.STATUS = #{status}, m.HOME_TEAM_ID = #{homeTeamId}, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = #{awayTeamId}, m.ENDED_AT = #{endedAtValue, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT) VALUES ( #{matchId}, #{matchDateValue, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{homeTeamId}, #{awayTeamId}, #{homeScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{awayScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{status}, #{notice, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{endedAtValue, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.MATCH_DATE, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'MM')) >= 8 THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) - 1 END AS SEASON, CEIL(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE ASC, m.MATCH_ID ASC) / 10) AS ROUND, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, m.STATUS, m.NOTICE, m.ENDED_AT, NVL(h.TEAM_NAME, '구단 ' || m.HOME_TEAM_ID) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, NVL(h.TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.TEAM_NAME) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.EMBLEM_URL AS HOME_EMBLEM_URL, h.HOME_GROUND, h.HOME_GROUND_KOR, NVL(a.TEAM_NAME, '구단 ' || m.AWAY_TEAM_ID) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME, NVL(a.TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.TEAM_NAME) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.EMBLEM_URL AS AWAY_EMBLEM_URL FROM MATCHES m LEFT JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE ASC, m.MATCH_ID ASC

SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.MATCH_DATE, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'MM')) >= 8 THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) - 1 END AS SEASON, CEIL(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE ASC, m.MATCH_ID ASC) / 10) AS ROUND, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, m.STATUS, m.NOTICE, m.ENDED_AT, NVL(h.TEAM_NAME, '구단 ' || m.HOME_TEAM_ID) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, NVL(h.TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.TEAM_NAME) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.EMBLEM_URL AS HOME_EMBLEM_URL, h.HOME_GROUND, h.HOME_GROUND_KOR, NVL(a.TEAM_NAME, '구단 ' || m.AWAY_TEAM_ID) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME, NVL(a.TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.TEAM_NAME) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.EMBLEM_URL AS AWAY_EMBLEM_URL FROM MATCHES m LEFT JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID WHERE (m.STATUS IN ('FINISHED', 'AWARDED') OR (m.HOME_SCORE IS NOT NULL AND m.AWAY_SCORE IS NOT NULL))
AND m.MATCH_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{season} || '-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND m.MATCH_DATE < TO_DATE((#{season} + 1) || '-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND (m.HOME_TEAM_ID = #{teamId} OR m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = #{teamId})
ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE DESC, m.MATCH_ID DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(MATCH_DATE, 'MM')) >= 8 THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) - 1 END AS SEASON, 1 AS ROUND, MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT FROM MATCHES WHERE MATCH_DATE >= #{startDate} AND MATCH_DATE <= #{endDate} ORDER BY MATCH_DATE ASC

SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.MATCH_DATE, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'MM')) >= 8 THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY')) - 1 END AS SEASON, 1 AS ROUND, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, m.STATUS, m.NOTICE, m.ENDED_AT, NVL(h.TEAM_NAME, '구단 ' || m.HOME_TEAM_ID) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, NVL(h.TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.TEAM_NAME) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.EMBLEM_URL AS HOME_EMBLEM_URL, h.HOME_GROUND, h.HOME_GROUND_KOR, NVL(a.TEAM_NAME, '구단 ' || m.AWAY_TEAM_ID) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME, NVL(a.TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.TEAM_NAME) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.EMBLEM_URL AS AWAY_EMBLEM_URL FROM MATCHES m LEFT JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID WHERE m.MATCH_ID = #{matchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MATCH_EVENTS ( MATCH_ID, TEAM_ID, EVENT_TIME, EVENT_TYPE, PLAYER_ID, ASSIST_PLAYER_ID ) VALUES ( #{matchId}, #{teamId}, #{eventTime}, #{eventType}, #{playerId}, #{assistPlayerId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, MATCH_ID, TEAM_ID, EVENT_TIME, EVENT_TYPE, PLAYER_ID, ASSIST_PLAYER_ID FROM MATCH_EVENTS WHERE MATCH_ID = #{matchId} ORDER BY EVENT_TIME ASC, EVENT_ID ASC
